audit.reasoning: 130: single stress, penult or antepenult by word length and penult weight). The classification (weight-sensitive right-edge rule: penult if long vowel, else antepenult, disyllables penult; heavy = CVV) is stated consistently by four independent sources (Routledge Hbk 2019:73 with examples, Rice 2023:129-130, Mithun 1999:467, Wikipedia citing Kimball 2005:396) all deriving from Kimball 2005, the best available and Glottolog-top description; nothing found suggests the coding is wrong, and no instrumental/phonology study of this extinct isolate exists.
